messages:
alex.m: Hi @people-ops — I got married last week. How do I add my spouse to medical + dental? When should we expect ID cards? Thanks!

people-ops: Congrats, alex! :tada: You should submit a life event in Rippling within 30 days so we can enroll your spouse. General checklist: marriage certificate (PDF/photo), spouse full name, DOB, and SSN for carrier enrollment. Effective date is usually the date of marriage if processed within the 30-day window, but some carriers default to the 1st of the next month — we can confirm for your plan.

alex.m: Awesome — does Rippling let me upload docs? Also my spouse has a doctor appt next week, any temporary proof I can use?

michelle.benefits: Yep — Rippling -> Benefits -> Add dependent -> select 'Marriage' life event and upload the marriage cert. For temporary proof: we can generate a proof-of-coverage letter same day once you submit the enrollment request. Carrier digital ID cards often show up in 48–72 business hours after carrier processes enrollment; physical cards take ~7–14 business days. If you need the letter, email benefits@redwood.com with spouse name + appointment date and we'll prioritize. :email:

alex.m: Do I have to put my spouse's SSN in Rippling? Prefer not to share over Slack.

michelle.benefits: You can upload the SSN securely in Rippling (recommended) or send it to benefits@redwood.com using the secure link. If you'd rather not do either, DM me and we can do a quick secure intake. Also a heads-up — dental/vision are on separate carriers (Delta Dental / VSP), they may take a different amount of time to issue cards.

benefits-bot: Enrollment submitted for alex.m — status: PENDING_CARRIER_VERIFICATION. Estimated digital ID availability: 2–5 business days. Physical card ETA: 7–14 business days. Reference: B-2026-045.

dan.s: If the carrier asks for more documentation or delays, open an HR ticket and we can escalate to our broker. Happened to me once — they needed an additional page from the marriage record.

people-ops: Quick reminders: (1) Qualifying events must be reported within 30 days. (2) If you miss that window we can try a retroactive appeal but it's not guaranteed by the carrier. (3) For urgent appointments, request the proof-of-coverage letter and bring a copy of the submitted Rippling confirmation. DM michelle.benefits if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
